description:
You are helping a hazmat team captain prepare a pre-incident plan for a chemical distribution warehouse. The captain needs to know what toxic decomposition products each stored chemical could release if involved in a fire.

Using the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), look up the following four chemicals and find the hazardous decomposition products listed in each chemical's Reactivity Profile section:

1. Sodium Azide (CAS 26628-22-8)
2. Carbon Disulfide (CAS 75-15-0)
3. Methyl Isocyanate (CAS 624-83-9)
4. Phosphorus Trichloride (CAS 7719-12-2)

For each chemical, search for it on CAMEO Chemicals, navigate to its datasheet, find the Reactivity Profile section, and record what hazardous decomposition products are listed.

Create a report file at ~/Documents/decomposition_report.txt with the following information for each chemical:
- Chemical name
- CAS number
- Hazardous decomposition products (exactly as described in the CAMEO Reactivity Profile)

Make sure each chemical has its own clearly labeled section in the report.
